source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Having an unusually wide therapeutic index overall, with fairly little risk of toxicity even at somewhat higher-than-typical doses","B":"Carrying fairly little risk of interacting with any of the client's other prescribed medications over the entire course of treatment","C":"Requiring fairly little ongoing monitoring at all once the client's therapy has first been established and appropriately stabilized","D":"Has a relatively narrow therapeutic index, and levels can be affected by many factors including other medications, making regular monitoring important"}}
source_row.rationale: Phenytoin has a relatively narrow therapeutic index, and levels can be affected by many factors including interactions with other medications and changes in protein binding, making regular serum level monitoring important to maintain therapeutic effect while avoiding toxicity.
source_row.source_detail: Narrow Therapeutic Index and Monitoring Needs
